name: sdei-delivery
description: Nine skills that carry a project from pre-sales material to production: capture the project profile, ingest discovery documents into a knowledge graph, write user stories and a database model with explicit human sign-off, generate the README, API contract and architecture docs, drive module-scale builds in plan mode, write tests keyed to acceptance criteria, validate delivered code against those criteria, and deploy. Every phase writes a committed artefact the next phase reads.
